responsibility: Ada language hook and front-end integration file that connects GNAT to GCC's generic driver and middle end. It implements startup and parse-file entry points that initialize the Ada runtime side and invoke gnat1, handles Ada-specific option decoding and option defaults, exports target floating-point mode queries and other miscellaneous helpers needed by Ada code, defines Ada-specific tree-node sizing/marking and lang-specific type allocation, and installs the LANG_HOOKS table including EH personality, gimplification, debug-name, type, and builtin hook selections for GNU Ada.
